data.sql: DELETE FROM planets WHERE name IN ('v3_pop05_pct_small','v3_pop05_pct_100','v3_pop05_pct_empty');

tests.name: Assert floor, proportional conservation, stoppage and empty-world exclusion

data.sql: SELECT (SELECT population=20 AND slave_unrest_stopped AND colonists_ore=10 AND colonists_org=5 AND colonists_eq=3 AND colonists_weapons=2 FROM planets WHERE name='v3_pop05_pct_small')::int,(SELECT COUNT(*)=1 AND MAX(applied_population_loss)=0 AND MAX(configured_population_loss_percent)=1 AND MAX(stoppage_until-EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW())::bigint) BETWEEN 0 AND 600 FROM planet_slave_unrest_events e JOIN planets p USING(planet_id) WHERE p.name='v3_pop05_pct_small')::int,(SELECT population=99 AND slave_unrest_stopped AND colonists_ore=49 AND colonists_org=25 AND colonists_eq=15 AND colonists_weapons=10 FROM planets WHERE name='v3_pop05_pct_100')::int,(SELECT COUNT(*)=1 AND MAX(applied_population_loss)=1 AND MAX(configured_population_loss_percent)=1 FROM planet_slave_unrest_events e JOIN planets p USING(planet_id) WHERE p.name='v3_pop05_pct_100')::int,(SELECT population=0 AND population_type='UNPOPULATED' AND NOT slave_unrest_stopped FROM planets WHERE name='v3_pop05_pct_empty')::int,(SELECT COUNT(*)=0 FROM planet_slave_unrest_events e JOIN planets p USING(planet_id) WHERE p.name='v3_pop05_pct_empty')::int;
DELETE FROM planets WHERE name IN ('v3_pop05_pct_small','v3_pop05_pct_100','v3_pop05_pct_empty');
